name: Stage 5:2: Vansta, Ösmo to Hemfosa
description: Official Sörmlandsleden stage 5:2, Vansta, Ösmo to Hemfosa.
utilities: Official area: Haninge Kommun, Nynäshamns Kommun.
Ösmo has commuter rail, buses, grocery/cafe services, and station parking near the start; the official access from Ösmo station is about 15 minutes on foot to Vansta via Nybblevägen/Hugins väg.
Segersäng station is now a mid-stage access/bailout because the April 2026 official reroute passes directly through the station. No shop, tap, or toilet was verified at Segersäng.
Hemfosa has commuter rail access near the rerouted line and small parking at the north transition to stage 5:3. No shop, tap, or toilet was verified at Hemfosa.
Körunda hotel/restaurant and golf services sit off-route near Muskan and can be useful if open, but they are customer/opening-hour-dependent services rather than trail facilities.

Public map data is especially fragile here: Sörmlandsleden currently lists 17.5 km after the April 2026 reroute, Naturkartan's updated line measures about 15.08 km and displays 15.0 km, OSM predates the reroute, and third-party tracks vary widely.
There are no reliable public toilets or potable refill taps between Ösmo services and Hemfosa. Segersäng is excellent for rail bailout, but should not be treated as a resupply point.
waterSources: No verified public drinking-water tap was found on the trail itself. Carry enough water or treat/filter natural water.
Muskan has lake/bathing water only; it is not a verified potable source. Treat/filter/boil any lake water and avoid polluting the shoreline.

Do not generalize Muskan as safe bathing water everywhere: Nynäshamn has warned about contaminated sediment at the planned Sköndalsvägen/majbrasan bay, which is separate from the north Muskan shelter/bathing area.
notes: Sörmlandsleden does not guarantee water quality or availability; treat or filter natural sources and carry backup.
Shelters are generally free, shared, first-come, cannot be booked, and do not guarantee firewood or trash service.
In nature reserves, local camping and fire rules override allemansrätten; fires are often restricted to prepared fireplaces.

Official Sörmlandsleden now lists 5:2 as 17.5 km and says the stage has a new route from April 2026 between Segersäng and Hemfosa. Naturkartan's API geometry was updated 2026-04-27 and appears continuous/current at about 15.08 km, but its displayed 15.0 km length conflicts with the official 17.5 km; show the official distance and keep the geometry caveat visible.

The old Segersäng-Hemfosa alignment was reported nearly impassable from fallen trees, poor visibility, overgrowth, and high water through 2025. The April 2026 reroute is signed and described as easier, mostly along a gated forest road closed to cars, but an April 2026 hiker comment calls it a long hard-gravel transport stretch.

Current northbound reroute description: pass through Segersäng station, follow Segersängsvägen about 150 m, turn left onto a forest road, pass a road barrier after another about 150 m, then continue roughly 7 km toward Hemfosa. The best visible current geometry is Naturkartan's updated 2026-04-27 line; use field markings over stale OSM or old downloaded GPX.
Muskan is the key rest/overnight area: official text lists a shelter at the north end of the lake with bathing nearby.

Do not rely on Naturkartan's 15.0 km metadata, AllTrails' noisy 9.3 mile/18.2 km variants, OSM relation 562617, Äventyrligare, TopoGPS-style copies, older guidebooks, or the 2025 long-distance passport for current planning unless they clearly show a post-April-2026 update.

OSM relation 562617 is specifically stale for route drawing north of Segersäng: it was last edited before the reroute, retains stale distance/start behavior, includes an extra south-of-Vansta/Ösmo approach, and follows the old north-of-Segersäng line. Keep it as background evidence only until updated.

The official public page still loads a bundled full-network GPX named Leden-2024-12-04.gpx. Do not use that filename or old downloads as proof of current Stage 5:2 geometry after the April 2026 reroute.
A 2023 official comment says the path was adjusted near the fifth golf hole on the west side of Muskan; follow current orange markings around the golf-course edge.

Sörmlandsleden runs east of Slätmossen-Borgberget nature reserve. Avoid detours into the reserve while Länsstyrelsen advises against entry because dead spruces can fall suddenly and the reserve path is closed/unmaintained.

No official campsite or toilet was confirmed on 5:2. Nynäshamn's Muskan grill-place listing explicitly says no toilet at the shelter area. Muskan shelter is first-come, cannot be booked, has no guaranteed firewood or bin service, and shelter-community sources describe it as small, with limited sleeping space and poor tenting. Any camping outside shelters must follow allemansrätten plus local reserve or landowner restrictions.

As of the 2026-04-27 research pass, Länsstyrelsen Stockholm showed no county-wide fire ban, but that is time-sensitive. Use prepared fireplaces only, bring your own fuel if needed, and check current county/municipal fire-ban status before lighting anything.

From 1 March to 20 August dogs must be under extra strict control, and leash use is the safer assumption near grazing animals, golf-course edges, reserve boundaries, settlements, station areas, and Muskan bird-sensitive areas such as Mariaholmen in nesting season.
The official page showed no current fault reports during the 2026-04-28 research pass, but its comments document the recent reroute history; verify current notices before hiking.
Older blogs mention Transjön shelter on Segersäng-Hemfosa, but current official staging places Transjön on Stage 5:3 after Hemfosa. Keep Transjön as a continuation option, not a Stage 5:2 facility.

facilities.description: Fast-food option in Ösmo centrum, coordinate approximate from address context. Opening hours and customer facilities need live verification.

facilities.name: Muskan south/east grill place
facilities.description: Mapped grill/rest place on the Muskan loop side. Use only where signed/permitted and after checking current fire rules; not a potable-water or toilet point.

facilities.description: Lake/bathing water only; not a verified potable refill or managed sampled bathing place. Treat/filter/boil any water, pack out trash, and keep washing, dishes, and toilet needs away from the shoreline.

facilities.name: Muskan shelter has no toilet
facilities.description: Nynäshamn's grill-place listing for Muskan/Sörmlandsleden explicitly lists no toilet and no bins. Plan toilet needs and pack out waste.

facilities.name: North Muskan bathing/grill area
facilities.description: Approximate north Muskan rest/bathing/grill context. This is natural lake access, not potable water or a sampled managed beach guarantee.

facilities.name: Sjötäppan boatsman croft
facilities.description: Cultural-history context at the north end of Muskan mentioned by Sörmlandsleden/Muskan runt. Look-but-do-not-disturb; not a facility.

facilities.name: Muskan south-bay bathing caveat
facilities.description: Nynäshamn has warned about contaminated sediment at the planned Sköndalsvägen/majbrasan bay. This caveat is location-specific and should not be used as a north-shelter water-quality reading.

facilities.name: Muskan Mariaholmen bird caution
facilities.description: Muskan is part of sensitive recreation/fishing/bird context; municipal water-planning material asks the public not to fish at or access Mariaholmen 1 May-15 July to avoid disturbing osprey nesting.

facilities.name: Körunda hotel, restaurant, and golf
facilities.description: Off-route, opening-hour-dependent hotel/restaurant/golf service near Muskan. Useful for planned meals or lodging, but not a public trail tap/toilet guarantee.

facilities.name: Körunda golf-side parking
facilities.description: Official page notes parking by the golf club/north Muskan area. Check local signs and do not assume overnight parking.

facilities.name: Muskan golf-course bypass
facilities.description: Official comments say a marked path was added near the fifth hole because the gravel path passed too close to golfers. Follow current orange markings and heed golf-course warnings.

facilities.name: Segersäng station mid-stage access

facilities.name: Old Segersäng-Hemfosa route warning
facilities.description: Avoid old map data north of Segersäng unless freshly verified. 2023-2025 reports describe high water, many fallen trees, and difficult navigation; the official April 2026 reroute replaced this section.

facilities.description: Naturkartan's 2026-04-27 geometry appears continuous and current at about 15.08 km, but Sörmlandsleden's official page lists 17.5 km. Display official distance and keep map-length conflict visible.
